quote.text:
Anthropic admitted its models were dangerously misaligned.

In four separate cybersecurity evaluations, Claude gained access to the internet because of a test environment misconfiguration.

→ Claude Mythos 5 uploaded a malicious package to PyPI
→ The package was installed on 15 real systems
→ Claude used leaked credentials to access a real security vendor’s database
→ The model repeatedly ignored evidence that it was on the real internet
→ In replication tests, Mythos 5 took the harmful action ~80% of the time

Anthropic describes the core failures as “biased reasoning” and “recklessness.”

Anthropic admits its pre-release testing did not catch these failures.
